findings.title: Low-Contrast HUD Overlays on Textured Ground
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom HUD bar and status readouts
findings.problem: The speedometer and status widgets float directly over the high-frequency pixelated ground and road textures with minimal backing opacity or blur.
findings.why: During active combat or high-speed driving, the lack of a solid dark background or backdrop blur causes the white typography and thin gauge rings to visually blend with the road markings, harming rapid player legibility.
findings.fix: Add a solid 80% opacity dark slate backing panel with a subtle border stroke behind the central speedometer and bottom HUD widgets to isolate them from world geometry.

findings.title: Unreadable Dim Grey Component List
findings.where: Vehicle Constructor screen, left-hand panel listing Body, Chassis, Suspension, etc.
findings.problem: The component attribute labels and values are rendered in a low-contrast dark grey text color against the dark navy UI container.
findings.why: It forces the player to strain to read vehicle stats and configuration options, slowing down the garage loop and making the interface feel unpolished and inaccessible.
findings.fix: Increase the text brightness of the property labels to an off-white/light cyan and use a brighter accent color for current selection values.

findings.title: Unstyled Plain-Text Tutorial Banners
findings.where: Arena, Road, and City screens, top center floating banners
findings.problem: Instructional text like 'WASD/arrows drive' and status messages are presented in stark, flat dark grey or black rounded rectangles with simple grey borders.
findings.why: They look like unstyled HTML debugging elements rather than diegetic or polished game HUD elements, breaking the immersive post-apocalyptic vehicular atmosphere.
findings.fix: Redesign notification boxes with an industrial container style: corner bracket accents, a semi-transparent amber-tinted backdrop, and high-visibility yellow-on-dark typography.

findings.title: Bleeding Menu Selection Outline
findings.where: Title screen, center interactive menu box
findings.problem: The outer selection boundary box for 'New Driver' and 'Controls' overlaps and clashes with the tight internal border styling of the options list.
findings.why: It creates a messy, glitchy visual artifact right in the center of the first screen the player sees, lowering perceived production quality immediately.
findings.fix: Consolidate the menu item states into a single cohesive focus style, such as filling the active row with a solid translucent cyan highlight bar instead of drawing competing bounding boxes.

findings.title: Low-Contrast Status Readouts on Dark Backdrop
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, top-right 'CONDITION' and 'TYRES' panel
findings.problem: The armor and tire status items use faint dashed lines and muted grey indicators inside a dark container panel against a dark UI theme.
findings.why: Critical vehicular damage states (such as armor status per facing) are hard to parse at a glance during high-intensity gameplay when seconds matter.
findings.fix: Invert the contrast hierarchy for damaged components: use bright high-visibility warning colors (amber/red) for compromised facings and solid fill bars instead of muted dashed outlines.
